newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes slightly higher, volume down.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes slightly higher, volume down.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed slightly higher on Friday but trade volume was lower, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 519.37, up from 518.31.
Total volume was 956,064 against 1.17 million dinars.
Chemical firm SPCD was up 1.02 dinar to 35.38 dinars with 2,100 shares changing hands. BTEI bank eased 0.16 dinar to 23.64 dinars with 7,260 shares traded.
